'''Krata''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] tracker and information broker living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was hired by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vette]] to learn the whereabouts of her sister [[Tivva]], though Vette mistakenly thought him a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] until their meeting. Krata eventually learned that Tivva was sold to [[Toobu]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and passed over that information to Vette in exchange for his fee.
